newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: RESEARCH ALERT-Argentine oil firms initiated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Argentine oil firms initiated.

text.p: Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette said it initiated coverage of Argentine oil companies YPF SA and Perez Companc with a buy rating.
It also initiated Argentine oil firm Astra, controlled by Spains' Repsol, as underperform.

"We are initiating coverage on YPF with a 'Buy' rating based on our belief that the company is trading at a historically high discount to its peers," analyst Jay Buthani, Phokion Potamianos and Caroline Evascu wrote in a report.
"We anticipate a target price of $37.20 for the next 9-12 months, which represents about 20 percent upside from the stock's current trading level of $30.75," they added.
They also said Perez Companc is "the" blue-chip energy company in Latin America and among the fastest growing and best managed firms available to investors in the emerging markets.
"Our 12-month price target for the stock is $9.40 per share, an upside of 17 percent from current levels."
Astra was rated an underperform due to its high valuation and dilution "caused by the poor strategy of over-paying for acquisitions.
"We forecast EPS of $0.115 for 1997 and $0.136 for 1998."
